stressScope: Literal stress forms were read on pages of the pinned normative PDFs. This verifies stress notation only, not by itself semantic relatedness, morphological analysis, or the school classification of the root.
ruleScope: Paragraph text read: §§13,15,16,18,19,34,35,36. Generic rules are not individual dictionary attestations for all 975 words.
rejectedDraftChecks: линять does not have stress on И; use линька for that position.
мелет does not prove О in молоть; use молотый.
предварить has stress on И, not А.
обаять and возразить do not check their preceding А by stress.
тираж has stress on А, not И; in тиражировать it checks А.
знакомый does not put А under stress.
промах has stress on О; a check for А must use another related form.
